targets.authors: Gabbard, J. L., Mehra, D. G., and Swan II, J. E.
targets.title: Effects of AR display context switching and focal distance switching on human performance.
targets.evidence_quote: Previously, Gabbard, Mehra, and Swan (2018) examined these issues, using a text-based visual search task and a monocular optical see-through AR display. In this work, the authors report a replication of this earlier experiment, using a custom-built AR haploscope.
targets.outcome_quote: The successful replication, on a very different display, is consistent with the hypothesis that the findings are a general property of AR.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall author verdict determines outcome.
